items.description_en: Drawing its power from our breakthrough anti-aging ingredient Myoxinol™, a neuropeptide extracted from Hibiscus Seeds, this transformative, multi-award-winning night cream delivers a remarkable youth boost in just 10 days. Clinically proven, this moisturizer is Ilene Forte's #1 bestseller worldwide. Myoxinol™ works by relaxing muscle contractions, providing a natural alternative to injectables. It targets mechanical aging by inhibiting muscle movement that leads to wrinkle formation, while its antioxidant effect combats biological aging by  neutralizing free radicals and protecting the skin from oxidative stress. Enhanced with Green Pea Polypeptides to support collagen and elastin synthesis, and Hyaluronic Acid to plump and hydrate, this formula is further enriched with omega-rich Olive Oil and a Tetra-Ceramide Complex to work in harmony with your body's natural circadian rhythm to enhance overnight moisture retention and rejuvenate the skin barrier. The Details. Vegan and cruelty-freeFree of parabens, mineral oil, phthalates, silicones, and artificial colors. Suitable for all skin types, especially mature or dry skin; certified for sensitive skinLeaves skin smooth, firm, replenished, hydrated and youthful. Proven to smooth wrinkles when used in a regime with Hibiscus Serum and Prickly Pear Face Cream (sold separately)Safe for use during pregnancy. 1.69 oz. Revolve Style No. IREF-WU11. Manufacturer Style No. FORR096F. Actual packaging and materials may vary. Please read labels, warnings, and directions before use. How to Use. After cleansing and applying serum and eye cream, dispense 1-2 pumps of moisturizer and gently massage into skin in upward motions until fully absorbed. Apply Hibiscus Night Cream in the evening.

items.name: African Adventures: The Greatest Safari On Earth
items.description: Descubra las cuatro experiencias legendarias del majestuoso continente africano: Victoria Falls "Mosi-Oa-Tunya" el humo que Thunders en Zimbabwe, el Delta de Okavango en Botswana, la Gran Migración en Kenia, y los gorilas de montaña Silverback en Ruanda. Hecho en Italia.
items.description_en: Embark on a magical journey into the African wilderness and be forever transformed. Witness the awe-inspiring interactions of lioness and her cubs or an elephant calf learning to use its trunk and be amazed at the natural wonders of Africa. African Adventures: The Greatest Safari on Earth, accompanied by the original photography of Aline Coquelle and the carefully curated itinerary of Zimbabwean Deborah Calmeyer, is your ticket to this extraordinary universe of freedom, possibility, and miracles. Discover the four legendary experiences of the majestic continent of Africa: Victoria Falls "Mosi-Oa-Tunya" the Smoke that Thunders in Zimbabwe, the Okavango Delta in Botswana, the Great Migration in Kenya, and the silverback mountain gorillas in Rwanda. This once-in-a-lifetime safari adventure takes you to each iconic destination, with front-row seats to sustainable boutique lodges, breathtaking helicopter rides, and thrilling wildlife explorations. Learn about the rich artistic heritage of each country and meet the most talented contemporary artists, conservationists, and designers, weaving a colorful cultural tapestry of the region's indigenous powerful culture. Silk hardcover. 300 pages with over 250 illustrations. Released June 2023. Made in Italy. Revolve Style No. ASSO-WH19. Manufacturer Style No. 9781649801999.

items.description_en: Experience a new level of skin softness and hydration with this non-greasy, all-natural, luxurious Belly and Body oil as part of your new daily ritual during pregnancy. Praised as liquid gold, this 1-selling oil harnesses powerful botanicals to elevate your body care regime when your skin needs it most. With a unique blend that prioritizes potent, natural ingredients commonly found in facial skincare, the PURE MAMA Belly oil is a powerful mix of high-performance botanicals that has been expertly formulated to boost skin elasticity and hydration, prevent the appearance of stretch marks, reduce the appearance of existing scaring, and ease skin tightness and itching. With a deliciously subtle, 100% natural, creamy coconut and caramel scent that isn't overpowering, it will leave you smelling like summer and your skin feeling silky smooth. The Details. Vegan and cruelty-freeFree of parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and synthetic fragrances. Helps with stretch marks, uneven skin tone, and dry skin. Fast absorbing, non-greasy, morning sickness friendly, gentle on skin, non-toxic, and plant-based. 4.90 oz. Revolve Style No. PMAM-WU1. Manufacturer Style No. PMBO01. Actual packaging and materials may vary. Please read labels, warnings, and directions before use. How to Use. Apply generously to your belly, boobs and hips twice daily throughout pregnancy from the first trimester. Allow dry time of 3-4 minutes. Do not use on broken or irritated skin. Patch test first. Store out of direct sunlight.

items.description_en: The Bur Bur Growing Season is a high performance botanical hair oil. A weekly treatment that visibly strengthens hair, adds shine, softness and supports healthy hair growth. Recommended to use at least once a week. The Details. Vegan and cruelty-freeFree of parabens. Burdock Oil is rich in essential fatty acids, deeply nourishes the scalp and strengthens hair follicles, promoting healthy hair growth and reducing hair thinning. Nettle Oil is a nutrient-rich botanical that helps combat hair loss by blocking DHT, a key factor in thinning hairIt boosts scalp circulation, promoting stronger, thicker hair growth while reducing dandruff. 50ml. Revolve Style No. BBUX-WU1. Manufacturer Style No. 0001. Actual packaging and materials may vary. Please read labels, warnings, and directions before use. How to Use. Apply the oil to dry hair prior to shampooing. Gently massage the product into your scalp and ensure it fully covers your hair from root to tip. Leave the product on for at least 45 minutes. For best results, leave it for 2+ hours. Shampoo and condition your hair as normal. For finer hair textures, a double cleanse is recommended. Use the treatment 1-2 times a week, ideally for a 90-day duration.
